title: Qualification records of closed stages still show pre-acceptance status (READY FOR AUDIT / BLOCKED) while the roadmap says CLOSED
affected_invariant: Roadmap formal closure vs qualification record (authority hierarchy)
impact: Acceptance of closure is recorded only in the roadmap; the stage records say not closed (AW-7C != CLOSED, EBH-4 parent BLOCKED, INT-CONFIG-REAL-X P0 BLOCKED). A reader of the record alone gets the opposite status.
recommendation: Owners append a closure/acceptance section (audit SHA, accepted scope, independence basis) to each record or mark it superseded by the roadmap row.

title: Independent audit acceptance for the batch is a roadmap assertion only: no audit report, no independence basis, no test logs
evidence: E1:docs/audit_results holds nothing after 2026-09-02; independent audits dated 2026-09-28..10-02 are not stored in the repo
impact: Q04 is PARTIAL and Q05 unstated for all nine stages, so none can reach CV-VERIFIED. Whether the audits were human Protocol 03, IIAC or delegate cannot be determined from the repo.
recommendation: Operator confirms the audit basis per stage (or supplies audit reports/digests) and the roadmap cites them; CAMPAIGN_B may re-execute the CERT suites.

title: EBH-3 R2 claim 'cross-domain integrations._shared.* production leakage = 0' is contradicted for agents/ and applications/; the gate scans only intergrax/
affected_invariant: FRZ-BND-03 / FRZ-OWN-01 (OPEN); EBH-3 R2 closure rule
impact: At baseline 8 non-test files (1 in agents/, 7 in applications/) import the private intergrax.integrations._shared.* package although the EBH-3 rule covers all production modules outside integrations/**. EBH-4 L248 calls such imports test/demo-only, but these are host factories. No hard tier-boundary break (downward import), but the closure claim and the gate scope disagree.
recommendation: CAMPAIGN_B: extend the gate scan root to agents/ and applications/ (or record an explicit sanctioned-exception list) and route imports through registry facades.

title: AW-7C child chain P2, P3, P4, CERT and CLOSURE has no closure rows or SHAs; the record shows them READY FOR AUDIT
impact: The parent cites a lineage 'P2-CERT' but only P0-3B, P1-ARCH, CLOSURE-R1, R1-R1 and PARENT-RECERT have ledger rows; the intermediate stages are never shown closed with SHAs.
recommendation: Add ledger rows for the missing children or state that they are folded into the parent certification.
